entries.0bbff3be4945eb0d: This business plans, designs, processes, manufactures and sells various metal products for the construction, energy, and machinery and equipment fields, among others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥8,002 million. Centered on consolidated subsidiary Nisso Pronity Co., Ltd., which handles solar array support frames and metal sandwich panels, among others, Ayame Seiki Co., Ltd. handles precision metal processing, Dairitsu Co., Ltd. handles air-conditioning-related equipment, Watanabe Technos Co., Ltd. handles soundproofing and noise-control equipment, and Tenjin Seisakusho Co., Ltd. handles livestock waste treatment equipment.
entries.0ece755196bb6af2: The Fourth Medium-Term Management Plan, established in October 2024, sets four items as medium-term management strategies toward forming the group vision of 'a corporate group that takes on the future with the power to create': promoting M&A investment, promoting up-front investment, expanding group support systems through the holding company structure, and promoting management conscious of the cost of capital. It positions M&A as a growth driver and states that it will steadily carry out PMI after execution.

entries.5420d2503aad5b08: This business plans, designs, processes, manufactures and sells various rubber, urethane and resin molded products for the residential, machinery and infrastructure fields, transport machinery and others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥2,734 million. Azuma Gomu Kogyo Co., Ltd., Taiho Co., Ltd., Formtex Co., Ltd. and Izumi Seisakusho Co., Ltd. handle this business, producing items such as seismic-resistant joints for sewer manholes, waterstop tape and resin products for vehicles. Furthermore, because the deemed acquisition date of Izumi Seisakusho Co., Ltd. is August 31, 2025, its results for the current period are not included in net sales.
entries.56f011bca1b01624: For the fiscal year ended August 2025, revenue rose 30.2% year on year, reflecting growth in interior and exterior panel-related construction work in the Construction Business and the contribution of Taiho Co., Ltd. and Formtex Co., Ltd., which became subsidiaries through M&A; however, profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥917 million (down 16.2%).

Having actively promoted M&A since the implementation stage of the First Medium-Term Management Plan, the company operates by appointing career employees of subsidiaries as presidents and directors to develop next-generation management talent.
entries.c3f2cae0e5b5f8f6: In the current consolidated fiscal year, revenue of the Chemical Products Business rose 174.9% year on year, reflecting the contribution of Taiho Co., Ltd. and Formtex Co., Ltd., which became subsidiaries through M&A, and revenue of the Construction Business rose 108.5% year on year on growth in interior and exterior panel-related construction work; as acquisitions and growth of existing businesses overlapped, revenue rose 30.2% year on year to ¥23,037 million. Following the transition to a holding company structure in June 2025, the company has shifted to a structure that promotes cross-group sales strategies and reduction of manufacturing costs.
